cog.guild_only: Use this command inside a server.
cog.manage_only: Only members who can manage this server can upgrade it.
cog.status_blurb: Premium is per server and renews monthly. It pays for the fal.ai moderation credits, bot hosting, and the upcoming niko domain.
cog.upgrade_price: **{price} / month** — cancel by simply not renewing.
cog.upgrade_blurb: Checkout opens our white-label payment page: choose a cryptocurrency, send it to the address shown, and premium activates the moment the transaction confirms.
cog.gift_active_note: -# This adds another month on top of the current subscription.
cog.gift_blurb: You can gift one, three, six or twelve months on the next screen. Your gift stays active even if you leave the server, and the owner is told who sent it.
cog.invalid_server_id: That is not a valid server ID.
cog.choose_server: Choose a server Niko is in to gift premium to.
cog.not_member: You have to be a member of **{server}** to gift it premium.
cog.gift_dm_body:
**{server}** now has Niko Premium for **{duration}**.

**Gifted by:** {gifter}
**Active until:** **{until}**

Premium includes AI image moderation, powered by fal.ai. You can turn it on in the dashboard under Moderation.
cog.payment_gift_note: The server owner has been notified about your gift.
cog.payment_thanks: Thanks for supporting Niko — this pays for the moderation API, hosting, and the upcoming domain.
cog.reminder_body:
**{server}**'s Niko Premium ends **{until}** (in {duration}).

Renewing keeps AI image moderation running without a gap. The monthly plan is **{price}**.
